description: This file defines the CellMatcher class, which is responsible for evaluating conditional formatting rules on spreadsheet cells, such as comparisons, duplicates, and expression-based conditions, using PHPExcel/PhpSpreadsheet library classes.

classes.name: CellMatcher
classes.description: A class that evaluates conditional formatting rules on a specific spreadsheet cell, including comparison operators, duplicates, and custom expressions in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellMatcher instance with a given cell and conditional range, setting up references and calculation engine.

methods.name: evaluateConditional
methods.description: Evaluates a given Conditional object on the current cell to determine if the condition is met.
